# Mobility · SandGrid's Tech Blog

> The personal tech blog of SandGrid (流沙): backend development and architecture design, covering Java, message queues, databases, cloud native, big data, and AI/LLM practices. Bilingual — the Chinese site lives at the root path, the English site at /en/.

- [About](https://lichuanyang.top/en/about/)
- [RSS feed](https://lichuanyang.top/en/atom.xml)

## Topics
- Java backend development and distributed architecture
- Message queues (ActiveMQ / Kafka and more)
- Databases and middleware
- Cloud native and big data
- AI / LLM engineering practice
- Book notes and personal reflections
